note: Names, descriptions and grades are as PlayStation publishes them. Guides are written for this entry in its own words, from the official descriptions and the cited sources. 28 of the 55 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the 54th other trophy unlocks — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order: story, strangers, activities, collectibles, then cleanup, and watch your progress at the top of this page.
steps: The platinum unlocks automatically with the last one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Play through it and the trophy pops at the end of the mission — it cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Chapters end on a story beat, so keep playing the missions in order until the chapter title card appears.
steps: Play through Chapter 1's missions in order.
The trophy pops at the chapter's final scene.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Like the other chapter trophies, it comes from playing the story straight through.
steps: Play through Chapter 2's missions in order.
The trophy pops at the chapter's final scene.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. The chapter trophies stack up as the story moves through Vice City.
steps: Play through Chapter 3's missions in order.
The trophy pops at the chapter's final scene.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4 and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale.
steps: Play through Chapter 4's missions in order.
The trophy pops at the chapter's final scene.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the story's final mission. It is gold because it marks the end of the whole story — after it, only side content and cleanup remain.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. Mission trophies like this one come from the story, so there is no special trick to them.
steps: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a story heist mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. Heist missions are the big set pieces, so enjoy the setup and the getaway.
steps: Reach The Cartel Heist in the story.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. Mission trophies unlock in story order, so keep following the missions.
steps: Reach the Child's Play mission in the story.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. The name hints at the mission's payoff, so play it for the scene as much as the trophy.
steps: Reach the Headliners mission in the story.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a story mission set around Vice City International Airport — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. The airport is also where the missable Catch Me If You Can trophy lives, so keep that in mind while you are there.
steps: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in the story.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a story mission — play it through and the trophy pops at the end. It is the last of the named mission trophies, so by the time it pops you are deep into the story.
steps: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in the story.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: 100% completion counts the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the big counters together. Save it for last — most of it finishes itself while you chase the other trophies. Check the in-game stats page to see exactly what is left.
steps: Finish the story and the stranger strands.
Mop up the counters (stunts, spending, laundering).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Stunts are jumps, near misses, airtime and drifts — the counter builds across the whole game, so do not grind it early. Use fast cars and bikes, the airport runways and the big highway jumps, and let it tick over while you play.
steps: Play normally — stunts count from the start.
Late in the game, chain jumps on the highways to finish the last stretch.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types in the game — try one of each. The activities menu in the pause screen lists exactly which nine count, and one try at each is enough: you do not need to win or finish them, just start one of each type.
steps: Open the activities list in the pause menu.
Try one of each of the 9 activity types.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 challenges across the range's courses. Gold needs accuracy and speed — use a steady weapon, aim for the high-value targets, and replay a course until the gold score lands. Do this early while your aim is fresh.
steps: Open the shooting range and try each course.
Replay the ones below gold until all 42 show gold.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: 14 drone-race locations. Learn each course's line first — fly it once slowly to learn the gates, then race it for the win. The tight corners are where races are won or lost.
steps: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun locations.
Win the race at each one.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Any 20 distinct races count — road, off-road, boat and air races all qualify. The counter tracks distinct races, so repeats do not help. Win one of each type as you find them across Leonida.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Cal is the fishing rival — challenge him at a fishing spot and out-fish him. Use the right bait for the spot, watch the tension meter and do not snap the line. The bigger catch wins.
steps: Find a fishing challenge with Cal.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Any arcade cabinet counts — finish one game start to end. The arcades are in Vice City's malls and bars; pick the game you are best at and play it through.
steps: Play one game through to its end.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy is a stranger — his strand is a chain of missions, and this trophy is its last one. Follow his markers whenever they appear and finish the chain to its final mission.
steps: Complete each mission in the chain.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton is a stranger — his strand is a chain of missions, and this trophy is its last one. Follow his markers whenever they appear and finish the chain to its final mission.
steps: Complete each mission in the chain.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy is a stranger — his strand is a chain of missions, and this trophy is its last one. Follow his markers whenever they appear and finish the chain to its final mission.
steps: Complete each mission in the chain.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight full stranger strands. A strand only counts when its final mission ends, so finish each chain you start instead of leaving them half done. The named stranger finals — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret's hunt — are most of the eight.
steps: Pick up stranger markers as you explore.
Complete 8 strands to their final missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy is a stranger — his strand is a chain of missions, and this trophy is its last one. Follow his markers whenever they appear and finish the chain to its final mission.
steps: Complete each mission in the chain.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone is a stranger — his strand is a chain of missions, and this trophy is its last one. Follow his markers whenever they appear and finish the chain to its final mission.
steps: Complete each mission in the chain.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 18 meditation spots at scenic overlooks and quiet corners across the state. The map marks a spot once you get close to it, so combine this with the exploration road trip — drive everywhere and meditate at each spot you find.
steps: Visit a meditation spot and meditate.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunt targets one unique animal — follow his clues to its territory, track it, and take the shot cleanly. Move slowly and shoot from cover so it does not bolt.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Cards are hidden across Leonida — in shops, bars and out-of-the-way spots. Three full sets is the goal; the collectibles menu shows which cards of each set you already have, so focus on the three sets closest to done instead of scattering across all of them.
steps: Pick up cards as you explore.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the photo challenge — snap the named spot at 100 locations across the state. The app marks each spot; drive the map and photograph them as you go. Combine it with the exploration and meditation trips, since all three reward the same road trip.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Challenges are the game's side objectives — any 50 count, across every type. They tick over while you play the rest of the game, so check the challenges menu and finish the ones that are nearly done first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Missable — this needs your partner beside you and a 4-star wanted level, then a clean escape together. Get the wanted level with your partner in the car, break line of sight, and hide until it clears. Do it the first time you have a partner beside you in free roam; partner moments are limited.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Missable — three shop robberies in a row, partner present, wanted level held the whole time. Plan a route with three close shops, rob fast, and keep moving. Do it while partner free-roam moments are available.
steps: Partner with you, pick three nearby shops.
Rob all three without losing the wanted level.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: The vehicle list fills as you drive new models — 100 distinct vehicles. Steal, borrow and buy across the map; the list shows what you have found. Entering a vehicle is enough — you do not need to own or keep it.
steps: Drive every new vehicle you see.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time — trigger it with five enemies in view and drop all five before it ends. A crowded street fight or a gang hideout is the place; use a fast-firing weapon and aim for the head.
steps: Down all five in one use.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Missable — leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way: take a plane from the runway or a hangar and take off without a scheduled flight. Be quick about it — airport security reacts fast. Do it as soon as you can reach the airport freely.
steps: Take a plane and depart by an unscheduled route.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Rhinos are the tanks — this trophy is about the tank encounter. Find a Rhino at a military area or in a high-wanted-level response, get into the thick of it, and survive. Use cover and explosives rather than trading shots head-on.
steps: Reach an area with Rhino tanks.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A clean jewelry heist: no alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level. Case the store, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted the run is blown — try again at another store.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Five bank vaults, each robbed and escaped cleanly. Vaults are the big jobs — plan the getaway before you go in, bring a fast car, and do not linger after the vault opens.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks run set routes — hit one, grab the cash and escape before the police close in. Use an explosive or a ram to stop it, grab the money, and get clear.
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: 52 areas — the map fills in as you visit each one. Drive every road and the counter fills; the last few are the remote corners and islands. Combine it with the meditation spots and the photo spots, since all of them reward the same driving.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: 9 gangs, one illegal operation each. Each gang's operation is marked once you find its turf — rob it and move to the next gang. One robbery per gang is enough.
steps: Rob one for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Missable — a quiet scene on Ocean Beach: order a cocktail and take in the view. It is tied to a specific story moment, so do it when the game offers it rather than assuming you can come back to the same scene later.
steps: Go to Ocean Beach when the story takes you there.
Enjoy the cocktail with the view.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Missable — a one-time story scene in a vehicle showroom: drive the car straight out through the glass instead of using the door. When the story puts you in the showroom with a car, floor it through the frontage.
steps: Reach the vehicle showroom story scene.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Missable — a story scene at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. When the story takes you to the alley, play the follow-through rather than leaving. Bowling itself is a repeatable activity, but this trophy is tied to the specific scene.
steps: Reach the Kolt & Associates bowling alley scene.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Missable — a partnership moment that only happens once in the story, where the duo's name gets out. Play the partner missions when they come up and let the scene play to the end rather than skipping past it.
steps: Let the scene resolve to the end.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The game tracks your choices — 500 of them, per PSN. Choices pile up across the story and side content: dialogue picks, approach choices in missions, decisions in side content. Just keep playing and choosing; the counter builds on its own.
steps: Make choices as the story offers them.
The counter reaches 500 across the game.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Missable — fail something once, then succeed on the very next attempt. The retry has to follow the failure directly, so pick a short challenge, fail it once on purpose, then pass it immediately after.
steps: Fail a mission or challenge once.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange: a UFO, a ghost, or one of Leonida's odd events. These happen at specific places and times, so check the strange spots at night and keep an eye out while exploring the back roads.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: A melee drive-by — swing a melee weapon from a moving vehicle and knock someone down like a bowling pin. Use a slow vehicle in a busy area so you can line the swing up, and pick a target standing still.
steps: Get a melee weapon and a slow vehicle.
Drive past a pedestrian and swing.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked bills come from heists — launder them through your contacts for clean cash. $250,000 total is the goal; it builds across the game's big jobs. Launder after every big score rather than letting marked bills pile up.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: $100,000 across every shop type — clothes, guns, cars, food. Spending counts from the start, so it builds while you play. If you are short at the end, spend the surplus on vehicle mods or the most expensive clothes you can find.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: 8 garage properties across Leonida — buy them all to store the fleet. They unlock as you progress; check the property listings and buy them as you find them rather than all at once.
steps: Buy garage properties as they unlock.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app registers vehicles you find — open it and register 10 of them. Any 10 vehicles count, so use the cheapest or most common ones you already have rather than hunting rare ones.
